description:
## About
Introduces the portfolio owner’s approach and background, summarizes strengths and skills, and links to Projects and Contact. Copy remains directly editable in the page; no credentials or biographical claims have been added.

Uses the shared navigation and card components, Bellini intrinsic auto-fitting grids, and supported visual styles without utility classes or custom CSS. A text-only color panel replaces imagery; no asset sources are assumed. Core actions and footer navigation use verified state links to bare sibling page names. Native keyboard focus remains intact.
